title: Central Bank Great Hall
purpose: Regulators sector card and monetary-authority surfaces.
story: The great hall of a central bank after hours — the quiet machinery of sovereign money, vast and unattended.
environment: A monumental banking hall, a long marble concourse beneath a vaulted ceiling, tellers' counters receding in shadow.
architecture: Beaux-arts institutional interior — paired stone columns, a deep barrel vault, a grand staircase ascending into darkness.
composition: A single shaft of warm light crossing the marble concourse, columns marching toward a dim vanishing point, vast negative space overhead.
continuityNotes: Keeps the set's near-black grade with one warm shaft and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
